breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: Dirichlet (u=0) and periodic. The agent correctly identified this conflict and, like the ground truth, removed the incorrect periodic condition, specifying only 'Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions with u = 0 on all four boundaries.'
